sloka: न हि किम्चिदयुक्तम् वा विप्रियम् वा पुरा मम ।अकरोस्त्वम् विशालाक्षि तेन न श्रद्दधाम्यहम् ॥२-१२-२०॥
transliteration: na hi kimcidayuktam vā vipriyam vā purā mama ।akarostvam viśālākṣi tena na śraddadhāmyaham ॥2-12-20॥

translations.english: O largeeyed lady, you have never done anything improper or unpalatable towards me in the past. Therefore I do not believe your words.
